changes.title: Kay Granger, Pathbreaking Texas Congresswoman, Dies at 83
changes.summary: She was the first Republican woman from the state to be elected to the House. It caused a stir in 2024 when she was discovered to be residing in a senior living facility while still in office.

changes.title: Kay Granger, first Republican woman from Texas to serve in the House, has died at age 83
changes.summary: Granger was the first woman elected mayor of Fort Worth, Texas, and the first Republican woman to chair one of the most powerful committees in Congress, the House Appropriations Committee.
